# Attikid

> Attikid is an independent music project featuring original music, album releases, a searchable song directory, and music-creation resources.

## Main pages

- Home: https://attikid.com/
- Albums and releases: https://attikid.com/albums
- Song directory: https://attikid.com/song-list
- Attikid Studio, songwriting and music creator tools: https://attikid.com/studio
- K!D Supply Co. clothing: https://attikid.com/supply-shop

## About the content

Attikid shares independent music and creative resources. The site's music pages provide album information and track listings. Attikid Studio provides tools intended to support songwriting, lyric development, rhyme exploration, song structure, music prompts, and release preparation.

For current release details, use the album and song pages on the official website.
